claims.text: The canonical AdminDesk Field source can be reconstructed from a hash-verified complete Git bundle.
The candidate is a verified single-executable Windows release ready for technicians.
The current CAMB and CLASS implementations are validated as equivalent for the PEER baseline.
The port reproduces CAMB-derived r_drag, sigma8, and thetastar at the exact historical K-PEER n=3 point.
The ACT nuisance kernel benchmark is 5.566x faster.
The validated-neighbor rdrag solution reduces background calls from 14 to 1 at the tested point.
The optimized likelihood changes the frozen historical objective by 1.54e-11.
The complete 174-evaluation campaign has a validated end-to-end speed multiplier.
